operators.name: ceil_forward
semantics: For each element x_i, compute ceil(x_i) in float32.
Equivalent to torch.ceil(x) on the input tensor.
Output dtype and device must match input; no broadcasting or shape change.

operators.name: reflection_pad2d_forward
semantics: Apply reflection padding on the last two dimensions (height and width).
Parameter order follows torch.nn.ReflectionPad2d(padding) where padding is (left, right, top, bottom).
Mirror indices are calculated as: if idx < pad, map to pad - idx; if idx >= pad + size, map to 2*size + pad - idx - 2, with clamping within original bounds.
Output is a copy of input with reflected borders, no padding value computation.
Output tensor must be allocated on the same device as input and contiguous.
Element-wise ceil operation, input float32, output same shape and dtype, device cuda.
ReflectionPad2d with padding (3,3,3,3): pad left=3, right=3, top=3, bottom=3.
Mirror indexing exactly as torch reflection padding.
Return the padded tensor, identical to step_002.
